title: World - Moor-bell toll (a)
_note: The Pearlmoor moor-bell: one deep harbour-bell strike rolling out over black water. A low bell fundamental + a quiet inharmonic upper partial (the 'clang') struck together, with a soft tri_bass thunk for the strike's body. Diegetic big-moment cue (the Causeway Bell / Tide-blessing) so it may luxuriate — render --tail 1.2 for the long silver ring-out.
